protocol.name: helix_screenshot_v1

description.summary: screen captures for the Helix shell

protocol.description: A private protocol between the Helix compositor and the Helix shell. The shell serves org.gnome.Shell.Screenshot on D-Bus; in GNOME the shell and the compositor are one process, in Helix they are separate, so the shell asks the compositor for the pixels with this protocol. The global is only advertised to privileged clients (the shell the compositor launched itself).

interface.name: helix_screenshot_manager_v1
interface.description: Each request captures the scene as it is when the compositor handles the request, so surfaces the shell destroyed before sending it are not in the image. The compositor writes a PNG image to the given file descriptor (from its current offset) and closes its copy, then sends done or failed on the new object. Coordinates are logical layout pixels; the image has as many pixels per logical pixel as the highest scale among the monitors it covers.

entry.name: shown
entry.summary: draw the pointer when it is inside

request.name: capture_screen
request.description: One image covering the bounding box of the layout; parts no monitor shows are transparent.

request.name: capture_area

description.summary: capture a rectangle of the layout

request.description: Width and height must be positive.

request.name: capture_window
request.description: The window's surfaces, cropped to its window geometry.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Captures in progress are not affected.

interface.name: helix_screenshot_frame_v1
interface.description: Receives exactly one done or failed event.

entry.name: invalid
entry.summary: empty area or nothing to capture

entry.name: failed
entry.summary: rendering or writing the image failed

event.name: done
event.description: The rectangle captured, in logical layout coordinates.
